{{Quote|What song, performed by the ensemble Plexo-33, was considered the most popular song in the galaxy, prior to the Clone Wars?|The Theed Palace librarian quizzing a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Plexo-33''' was a mechanical band that played around the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. They released a song named "[[11011101 2|11011101 #2]]" which became one of the most famous songs in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] at that time.
